intro.text: Rock's second son, named after a smaller kind of rock than his father.

items.text: Rock came to the Shattered Plains with his family after months of travel. When Voidbringers attacked their caravan the family held out behind a pile of furniture until Bridge Four found them and took them to Urithiru, where he helped his father serve food to the crew.
After Hearthstone was evacuated, Rock went back to the Peaks with most of his family; only Cord and Gift stayed.

personality.text: By his people's traditions he has the honour of gathering food.
